reply: No, nothing on Ethos is monthly. Templates, "Make it special" and game packs are one-time payments that stay on your account for good, for example one template is €9.99 or every template is €24.99. Ethos for Two is €29.99 for a full year, paid once, and it doesn't renew by itself: you get a reminder email two weeks before it ends. The Letter and Constellations are free.

One template is $11.99, paid once, and it's yours for good: make it as often as you like, with your voice or video, up to 20 photos and no footer, and it can open at midnight on their day with only them able to open it. If you'd like more, Pick three is $17.99 for any three templates, and Everything is $29.99 for all templates, now and future. You can see it all at tryethos.io/pricing.

Make it special is £6.49, paid once, for a free template (The Letter or Constellations). It adds that template's paid extras for good: a video, a voice message, up to 20 photos, no footer, scheduling and a password.

We don't run discount codes: the price shown is the same for everyone. What is free: The Letter and Constellations templates, a full live demo of every template, the editor with its live preview, and sending a gift back once in the same template when you receive a paid one. If you'd like more than one template, Pick three is €14.99 and Everything is €24.99, both paid once.

Yes. Every template has a free live demo: open it on tryethos.io/templates and play it from its page. The editor is free too, with a live preview, and you only pay when you publish something that needs a premium feature. The Letter and Constellations are free to use in full.

For free you can find and plan dates near you and send them as a link (with the forecast and sunset), use the long-distance tools and play the games, and a free account keeps up to three saved dates or trips. For gifts, two full templates are free, The Letter and Constellations, with unlimited gifts, up to 10 photos each, our music library, a 30-second preview of a real song, a countdown and a hidden final surprise, plus a small "Made with Ethos" footer. Every template also has a free live demo, and the editor is free to use with a live preview. If someone sends you a paid gift, you can send one back in the same template for free, once.
No, gift links don't expire: they're meant to be permanent. If that ever had to change, you'd get at least 90 days' notice.
Yes, you can. Sign in, open My gifts at tryethos.io/dashboard, and tap "Edit" on the gift. Your changes go live at the same link as soon as you publish them, so there's no need to send a new link.
Yes. Checkout is on Stripe's secure page, where you can pay by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and other methods. You'll see the final amount in your currency before you pay.

Ethos for Two is a year of everything for the two of you, for $34.99 paid once. You both get unlimited saved dates and trips, planned and edited together on both your phones, a reminder the day before each date, a whole date opened in Apple or Google Maps, and every gift template and game pack. One of you pays and the other joins with the invite link you send. It lasts 365 days and doesn't renew by itself; we email you two weeks before it ends.

Yes. Whoever receives a gift you paid for (made with a premium template) can send you one back in the same template for free, once, with the small "Made with Ethos" footer. If they want extras like a video, voice message or no footer on their reply, they pay that template's normal price.

Yes, a gift can be scheduled to unlock at a set time, so it can open at midnight on her birthday. Scheduling comes with any template unlock (One template is €9.99, paid once), with Ethos for Two, or with "Make it special" (€7.49) on the free templates The Letter or Constellations. You can try the editor and every template's live demo for free first at tryethos.io/templates.

Yes. The Letter is free, and voice messages come with "Make it special" for €7.49, paid once, which also adds video, up to 20 photos, no footer, scheduling and a password to that template for good. No, there's no app to download. The gift opens in any phone or computer browser from the link or QR code you send, and he doesn't need an account either.

Here's how to find it. A gift stays on the phone or computer it was made on until it's published.
1. Sign in with the email you paid with, on that same phone or computer.
2. Open My gifts (tryethos.io/dashboard): at the top it says "Your (template) gift is paid for", so tap "Finish and send it".
3. On a different phone, the draft isn't there: make the gift again in the same template; it's already unlocked on your account, so there's nothing more to pay.

No, en Ethos no hay pagos mensuales. Las plantillas, "Make it special" y los packs de juegos se pagan una sola vez y son tuyos para siempre. Ethos for Two cuesta 29,99 € por un año, se paga una vez y no se renueva solo: te enviamos un email de aviso dos semanas antes de que termine. Además, The Letter y Constellations son gratis.

Si pagaste como invitado, el regalo se guarda en el teléfono u ordenador donde lo hiciste hasta que se publica. Sigue estos pasos:
1. Inicia sesión con el mismo email con el que pagaste, en ese mismo teléfono u ordenador.
2. Abre Mis regalos (tryethos.io/dashboard).
3. Arriba verás "Tu regalo (plantilla) está pagado": toca "Terminar y enviarlo".
4. Si estás en otro dispositivo, vuelve a crear el regalo con la misma plantilla: ya está desbloqueada en tu cuenta, así que no tendrás que pagar nada más.
